title: Fixed Opposed Shoulders and Open Sided Hand Bay Unit
description: One wholly newly authored complete hands-in-dryer-style appliance exterior in a fixed empty standing presentation. A single continuous tall body grows into two unequal-height opposed thick upper shoulders, leaving a genuine deep top-open and both-side-open hand bay between them. Its continuous bottom closes the bay above the lower body; a whole shallow collecting-tray appearance sits in that bottom. Each opposing shoulder carries one complete long recessed slot rail facing inward. A plain proud lower service-panel appearance and a small blank upper indicator complete the unit. Unlike the complete shoe-polisher low front bay with transverse brush rolls, this has no roof, brushes or foot mat; unlike the inverted-bottle cabinet, it has no upper reservoir, taps or front-only cup alcove. The complete crosswise open upper bay is newly authored as one connected thick body, not an old cabinet with its accessories removed. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and complete centred ground datum, one model zero scenes. No hands or water. Static artistic appliance exterior only: no air supply, drying, hygiene, sanitization, sensors, plumbing, human fit, electrical function, installation, manufacture or safe use capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
